requirement: Prior to conducting activities pursuant to the SAP, the Lessee must hold a briefing to establish responsibilities of each party involved in implementing the requirements specified in Section 1 of these conditions. During this briefing, the parties involved must define the chains of command, discuss communication procedures, provide an overview of monitoring procedures, and review operational procedures. This briefing must include all relevant personnel, crew members, and protected species observers (PSOs). New personnel must be briefed as they join the work in progress.
related_domains: safety training; personnel management; environmental monitoring

requirement: The Lessee must ensure that all vessel operators and crew members, including PSOs, are familiar with and understand the requirements specified in these conditions.
scope: All vessel operators and crew members
related_domains: safety training; personnel management

requirement: The Lessee must ensure that a copy of these conditions is made available on every project-related vessel.
related_domains: safety documentation; vessel operations

requirement: The Lessee must ensure that all vessels conducting activities authorized under its SAP comply with the vessel-strike avoidance measures specified below, except under extraordinary circumstances when the safety of the vessel or the safety of life at sea is in question.
scope: All vessels operating under the SAP
related_domains: marine mammal protection; sea turtle protection; vessel operations

requirement: The Lessee must ensure that vessel operators and crews maintain a vigilant watch for marine mammals and sea turtles and slow down or stop their vessel to avoid striking these protected species.
related_domains: marine mammal protection; sea turtle protection; vessel operations

requirement: The Lessee must ensure that vessel operators comply with 10 knot (18.5 km/hr) or less speed restrictions in the following circumstances: All vessels operating in any Dynamic Management Area (DMA).
scope: All vessels operating in a DMA
related_domains: marine mammal protection; sea turtle protection; vessel operations; speed restrictions

requirement: The Lessee must ensure that vessel operators comply with 10 knot (18.5 km/hr) or less speed restrictions in the following circumstances: All vessels 19.8 m (65 ft) in length or greater, traveling and operating within the project area and between the staging area/port and the project area from November 1 through April 30.
scope: Vessels 19.8m or greater within the project area and between the staging area/port and the project area from November 1 through April 30
related_domains: marine mammal protection; sea turtle protection; vessel operations; speed restrictions

requirement: The Lessee must ensure that vessel operators comply with 10 knot (18.5 km/hr) or less speed restrictions in the following circumstances: When mother/calf pairs, pods, or large assemblages of cetaceans are observed near any vessel.
scope: All vessels near mother/calf pairs, pods, or large assemblages of cetaceans
related_domains: marine mammal protection; vessel operations; speed restrictions

requirement: The Lessee must ensure all vessels maintain a separation distance of 500 meters (1,640 ft) or greater from any sighted North Atlantic right whale.
related_domains: marine mammal protection; North Atlantic right whale protection; vessel operations

requirement: If underway, any vessel must steer a course away from the North Atlantic right whale at 10 knots (18.5 km/h) or less until the 500 meter (1,640 ft) minimum separation distance has been established (unless 1.3.2.2 below applies).
scope: Vessel operations within 500 meters of North Atlantic right whales
related_domains: marine mammal protection; vessel operation

requirement: If a North Atlantic right whale is sighted within 100 meters (328 ft) of an underway vessel, the vessel operator must immediately reduce speed and promptly shift the engine to neutral.
scope: Vessel operations within 100 meters of North Atlantic right whales
related_domains: marine mammal protection; vessel operation

requirement: The vessel operator must not engage the engines until the North Atlantic right whale has moved beyond 100 meters (328 ft).
scope: Vessel operations near North Atlantic right whales
related_domains: marine mammal protection; vessel operation

requirement: If a vessel is stationary, the vessel operator must not engage engines until the North Atlantic right whale has moved beyond 100 meters (328 ft).
scope: Stationary vessels near North Atlantic right whales
related_domains: marine mammal protection; vessel operation

requirement: The Lessee must ensure all vessels maintain a separation distance of 100 meters (328 ft) or greater from any sighted non-delphinoid cetacean.
related_domains: marine mammal protection; vessel operation

requirement: If any non-delphinoid cetacean is sighted, the vessel underway must reduce speed and shift the engine to neutral, and must not engage the engines until the non-delphinoid cetacean has moved beyond 100 meters (328 ft).
scope: Vessel operations within 100 meters of non-delphinoid cetaceans
related_domains: marine mammal protection; vessel operation

requirement: If a vessel is stationary, the vessel must not engage engines until the non-delphinoid cetacean has moved beyond 100 meters (328 ft).
related_domains: marine mammal protection; vessel operation

requirement: The Lessee must ensure that vessels underway do not divert to approach any delphinoid cetacean and/or pinniped.
scope: Vessel operations near delphinoid cetaceans and pinnipeds
related_domains: marine mammal protection; vessel operation

requirement: The Lessee must ensure that all vessels maintain a separation distance of 50 m (164 ft) or greater from any sighted delphinoid cetacean or pinniped, except if the delphinoid and/or pinniped approach the vessel
scope: Vessel operations near delphinoid cetaceans and pinnipeds
related_domains: marine mammal protection; vessel operation

requirement: The Lessee must ensure that if a delphinoid cetacean and/or pinniped approaches any vessel underway, that vessel must avoid excessive speed or abrupt changes in direction to avoid injury to the delphinoid cetacean and/or pinniped.
scope: Vessel operations near delphinoid cetaceans and pinnipeds
related_domains: marine mammal protection; vessel operation

requirement: The Lessee must ensure all vessels maintain a separation distance of 50 meters (164 ft) or greater from any sighted sea turtle.
related_domains: marine wildlife protection; vessel operation

requirement: The Lessee must ensure that vessel operators, employees, and contractors engaged in activities pursuant to the SAP are briefed on marine trash and debris awareness elimination as described in BSEE NTL No. 2015-G03 (“Marine Trash and Debris Awareness and Elimination”).
related_domains: pollution prevention; waste management

requirement: The Lessee must ensure that all vessels conducting activity pursuant to the SAP comply with the pile driving and reporting requirements specified in Sections 1.8 and 1.9, except when the safety of the vessel or the safety of life at sea is in question.
related_domains: maritime safety; construction

requirement: The Lessee must not conduct pile driving for a meteorological foundation at any time when lighting or weather conditions (e.g., darkness, rain, fog or sea state) prevent visual monitoring of the exclusion zones for meteorological foundation pile driving.
related_domains: construction; visibility requirements

requirement: If the driving of a pile commenced during daylight hours, then the Lessee may complete driving that pile after daylight hours. However, the Lessee may not start driving a new pile after daylight hours, unless allowed pursuant to an alternative monitoring plan as described in 1.8.4.
related_domains: construction; time of operation

requirement: The Lessee must ensure that the exclusion zone for all pile driving for a meteorological tower foundation is monitored by NMFS-approved PSOs around the sound source. The number of PSOs must be sufficient to effectively monitor the exclusion zone at all times.
related_domains: marine wildlife protection; construction; monitoring

requirement: must not be on watch for more than 4 consecutive hours, with at least a 2-hour break after a 4-hour watch, unless a different schedule is approved by the Lessor
related_domains: personnel safety; protected species observation

requirement: PSOs must not work for more than 12 hours in a 24-hour period
related_domains: personnel safety; protected species observation

requirement: Prior to the scheduled start of meteorological tower foundation construction activity, the Lessee must provide to the Lessor a list of PSOs currently approved by NMFS for these activities.
related_domains: protected species observation; environmental impact assessment

requirement: For PSOs not currently approved by NMFS, the Lessee must provide to the Lessor PSO résumés no later than forty-five (45) calendar days prior to the scheduled start of meteorological tower foundation construction activity.
related_domains: protected species observation; environmental impact assessment

requirement: If additional PSO approvals are required after this time, the Lessee must provide additional résumés to the Lessor fifteen (15) calendar days prior to each PSO’s start date.
related_domains: protected species observation; environmental impact assessment

requirement: The Lessee must ensure that monitoring occurs from the highest available vantage point on the associated operational platform and allows for 360° scanning.
related_domains: protected species observation

requirement: The Lessee must ensure that reticle binoculars and other suitable equipment are available to each PSO to adequately perceive and monitor protected species within the exclusion zone during construction activities.
related_domains: protected species observation

requirement: The Lessee must ensure that no pile driving activities occur within an active DMA as established by NMFS.
related_domains: marine mammal protection; pile driving operations

requirement: Any pile driving activities outside of the DMA are required to remain at a 7 km (22,966 ft) distance from the DMA boundaries.
related_domains: marine mammal protection; pile driving operations

requirement: The Lessee must ensure the establishment of a default 7 km (22,966 ft) radius exclusion zone for marine mammals and sea turtles around each pile driving site.
related_domains: marine mammal protection; sea turtle protection; pile driving operations

requirement: The 7 km (22,966 ft) exclusion zone must be monitored from two locations.
related_domains: marine mammal protection; sea turtle protection; pile driving operations

requirement: At least two PSOs on simultaneous watch must be based at or near the sound source and will be responsible for monitoring out to 1,000 m (3,281 ft) from the sound source.
related_domains: marine mammal protection; sea turtle protection; pile driving operations; protected species observation

requirement: At least two additional PSOs on simultaneous watch must be located on a separate vessel navigating approximately 4-5 km (13,123- 16,404 ft) around the pile hammer, and will be responsible for monitoring 360° out to 7 km (22,966 ft) from the sound source.
related_domains: marine mammal protection; sea turtle protection; pile driving operations; protected species observation

requirement: Sound pressure levels must be measured in the field in dB re 1 μPa RMS, and reported by the Lessee to the Lessor and NMFS.
related_domains: noise pollution; marine mammal protection

requirement: The Lessee must report the azimuthal bearing from the central pile to the receivers.
related_domains: noise pollution; marine mammal protection; data acquisition

requirement: The Lessee must record the bearings from the central caisson to the strike surfaces of each caisson brace pile, as well as the bearing from the central caisson to where each caisson brace pile enters the ocean floor.
related_domains: structural integrity; positioning; data acquisition

requirement: The Lessee must submit results of the acoustic monitoring for field verification of the exclusion zone to the Lessor.
related_domains: noise pollution; marine mammal protection; monitoring

requirement: If the Lessor determines that the exclusion zone does not encompass the cumulative sound exposure distance for PTS for each marine mammal hearing group, the Lessor may impose additional, relevant requirements on the Lessee, including, but not limited to, the implementation of a sound reduction system.
related_domains: noise pollution; marine mammal protection; mitigation

requirement: Field verification would be required for any sound reduction system.
related_domains: noise pollution; marine mammal protection; mitigation; verification

requirement: The Lessee must use the results of its field verification in establishing any new exclusion zone, regardless of whether it is greater than or less than the default exclusion zone.
related_domains: noise pollution; marine mammal protection; monitoring

requirement: Any new exclusion zone radius must be based on the average SEL measurement (SEL 50) obtained from field verification.
related_domains: noise pollution; marine mammal protection; monitoring

requirement: The new exclusion zone must minimize the risk of PTS for the most sensitive species in the project area.
related_domains: noise pollution; marine mammal protection; impact assessment

requirement: The Lessee must obtain the Lessor and NMFS’s approval for any new exclusion zone before it may be implemented.
related_domains: permitting; environmental law

requirement: The Lessee must ensure that visual monitoring of the exclusion zone begins no less than 60 minutes prior to the start of any pile driving operations and continues for at least 60 minutes after pile driving operations cease, unless sighting conditions do not allow observation of the sea surface (e.g., fog, rain, darkness).
related_domains: marine mammal observation; protected species observation; monitoring

requirement: The Lessee must ensure that pile driving operations do not begin until the PSO has reported the exclusion zone clear of all marine mammals and sea turtles for at least 60 minutes.
related_domains: marine mammal protection; protected species protection; construction

requirement: The Lessee must ensure that a “soft start” be implemented at the beginning of each pile installation.
related_domains: noise pollution mitigation; marine mammal protection; protected species protection

requirement: The Lessee must ensure that any time a marine mammal or sea turtle is observed within the exclusion zone, the PSO will notify the Resident Engineer or other authorized individual, and call for a shutdown of pile driving activity.
related_domains: marine mammal protection; sea turtle protection; environmental impact mitigation

requirement: Subsequent restart of the pile driving equipment may only occur following clearance of the exclusion zone of any marine mammal or sea turtle for at least 60 minutes.
related_domains: marine mammal protection; sea turtle protection; environmental impact mitigation

requirement: Thereafter, the Lessee must undertake a soft start prior to proceeding with pile driving operations (per Section 1.8.13).
related_domains: noise mitigation; construction procedures

requirement: The Lessee must ensure that restart of the pile driving activity commences only after clearance of the exclusion zone (per Section 1.8.12) and implementation of soft start procedures (per Section 1.8.13) in the following circumstances: 1.8.15.1 If visual surveys are not able to be continued diligently during any pause in pile driving activity due to diminished lighting or weather conditions (e.g., darkness, rain, fog or sea state). 1.8.15.2 If pile driving activity shuts down for reasons other than encroachment into the exclusion zone by a non-delphinoid cetacean or sea turtle (for instance, mechanical or electronic failure), resulting in the cessation of the sound source for a period of 60 minutes or more.
related_domains: visual monitoring; construction procedures; environmental impact mitigation

requirement: The Lessee must notify the Lessor and NMFS at least 24 hours prior to the initial commencement of pile driving activities, and again within 24 hours of the completion of all pile driving activities.
related_domains: reporting requirements; environmental monitoring

requirement: The Lessee must ensure that the PSOs record all observations of protected species using standard marine mammal observer data collection protocols.
related_domains: protected species observation; data collection; environmental monitoring

requirement: sightings of any injured or dead protected species (e.g., marine mammals, sea turtles, or sturgeon) are reported to the Lessor, NMFS, and NMFS Northeast Regional Stranding Hotline within 24 hours of sighting, regardless of how the injury or death was caused
scope: Offshore wind farm construction and operation
related_domains: protected species; marine mammals; sea turtles; sturgeon; incident reporting

requirement: If the Lessee’s activity is responsible for the injury or death, the Lessee must ensure that its vessel assist in any salvage effort as requested by NMFS.
scope: Offshore wind farm construction and operation
related_domains: protected species; marine mammals; sea turtles; sturgeon; incident response

requirement: report any observed takes of listed marine mammals, sea turtles, or sturgeon resulting in injury or mortality within 24 hours to the Lessor and NMFS
scope: Offshore wind farm construction and operation
related_domains: protected species; marine mammals; sea turtles; sturgeon; take reporting

requirement: report any observations concerning any impacts on ESA-listed marine mammals, sea turtles, or sturgeon to the Lessor and NMFS’ Northeast Region Stranding Hotline within 48 hours
scope: Offshore wind farm construction and operation
related_domains: protected species; marine mammals; sea turtles; sturgeon; impact reporting

requirement: the results of acoustic monitoring of the first pile are submitted to the Lessor and NMFS within 24 hours of installation
related_domains: acoustic monitoring; pile driving; noise pollution

requirement: notify the Lessor and NMFS within 24 hours of receiving any acoustic monitoring results which indicate that any exclusion or monitoring zones do not cover the cumulative sound exposure distances for PTS during pile driving activities
related_domains: acoustic monitoring; pile driving; noise pollution; safety zones

requirement: The Lessee may only modify an exclusion zone or monitoring zone with written approval from the Lessor and NMFS
related_domains: acoustic monitoring; pile driving; noise pollution; safety zones

requirement: provide to the Lessor and NMFS a final technical report within 120 calendar days of completion of the pile driving and other construction activities
related_domains: reporting; environmental impact assessment

requirement: The Lessee must use only red flashing strobe-like lights be consistent with the Federal Aviation Administration requirements for meteorological towers.
related_domains: aviation safety; lighting

requirement: These aviation obstruction lights must emit infrared energy within 675-900 nanometers wavelength to be compatible with Department of Defense night vision goggle equipment.
related_domains: aviation safety; lighting; defense

requirement: Navigational safety lights for towers and buoys must be installed in compliance with the US Coast Guard (USCG) requirements (https://www.uscg.mil/forms/cg/CG_2554.pdf).
related_domains: navigation safety; lighting

requirement: The Lessee must leave any additional lights (e.g., work lights) on only when necessary, hooded downward and directed when possible to reduce upward illumination and illumination of adjacent waters.
related_domains: light pollution; avian protection; marine environment

requirement: The Lessee must install anti-perching devices on the meteorological tower.
related_domains: avian protection

requirement: The Lessee must install a visibility sensor on the meteorological tower to provide measures of visibility.
related_domains: meteorological data; safety

requirement: The Lessee must provide an annual report on November 1 of each year to the Lessor documenting any dead birds or bats found on vessels and structures during construction, operation, and decommissioning of the meteorological tower.
related_domains: avian protection; environmental monitoring; reporting

requirement: Carcasses with Federal or research bands must be reported to the US Geological Survey Bird Band Laboratory (https://www.pwrc.usgs.gov/bbl/).
related_domains: avian protection; wildlife research; reporting

requirement: The Lessee must not knowingly impact a potential archaeological resource without the Lessor’s prior approval.
related_domains: archaeological resource protection; cultural heritage

requirement: Immediately halt seafloor/bottom-disturbing activities within the area of discovery
related_domains: archaeological resource protection; cultural heritage

requirement: Notify the Lessor within 24 hours of discovery
related_domains: archaeological resource protection; cultural heritage; reporting

requirement: Notify the Lessor in writing via report to BOEM within 72 hours of its discovery
related_domains: archaeological resource protection; cultural heritage; reporting

requirement: Keep the location of the discovery confidential and take no action that may adversely affect the archaeological resource until the Lessor conducts an evaluation and instructs the applicant on how to proceed
related_domains: archaeological resource protection; cultural heritage; confidentiality

requirement: Conduct any additional investigations as directed by the Lessor to determine if the resource is eligible for listing in the National Register of Historic Places (NRHP) (30 CFR § 585.802(b))
related_domains: archaeological resource protection; cultural heritage; National Register of Historic Places

requirement: As part of the required annual self-inspection plan (pursuant to 30 CFR § 585.824), the Lessee must conduct scour inspections of the base of the meteorological tower.
related_domains: structural integrity; scour protection; inspection; maintenance

requirement: The first inspection will be conducted within 12 months of installation.
scope: Meteorological tower scour protection - initial inspection
related_domains: structural integrity; scour protection; inspection; maintenance

requirement: The Lessee must file an application (form CG-4143), either in paper form or electronically, with the commander of the USCG Fifth District to establish private aid to maritime navigation (PATON) for the meteorological tower, per 33 CFR Part 67, Subpart 67.20 for Class A structures.
related_domains: navigational safety; private aids to navigation

requirement: The Lessee must submit to the Lessor within 90 days after installation of the facility a narrative report that contains a summary of the fabrication and deployment process
related_domains: reporting; documentation; construction

related_domains: protected species; marine wildlife; environmental monitoring

scope: Offshore wind farm operation (during visual surveys for protected species)
related_domains: marine mammal monitoring; protected species observation; environmental impact assessment

requirement: Photographs/Video should be taken of all injured or dead animals.
scope: Offshore wind farm operation (in case of protected species injury or mortality)
